nom: Simplified Skin Rose Water Spray for Face & Hair

segments.sensitive: The great majority of reviewers who describe sensitive skin, including one with a history of hives or rashes from new products and one with a sensitive scalp, report no irritation and a calming effect, though one reviewer says it broke her face out in small allergy bumps even though it worked well on her hair.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one dealing with air-conditioning and mask-related dryness, generally report a noticeable boost in comfort and hydration, though one reviewer notes it works better as a refreshing mist layered under a moisturizer than as a deep hydrator on its own for very dry skin.
segments.oily: The one reviewer who describes oily, blemish-picking skin reports a big improvement after adding this spray to her routine, though she used it alongside other products rather than on its own.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe an immediate boost in hydration and freshness after misting, useful as a midday pick-me-up in dry or air-conditioned environments; one critical reviewer instead reports her skin turned terribly dry after use and suspected hidden alcohol in her batch, and another notes it works better layered with a moisturizer than as a stand-alone deep hydrator for very dry skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the mist calmed irritation, including redness from mask friction and from scrubbing during cleansing, with one noting a brief tingling on first use that settled without causing irritation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically credits the low molecular weight hyaluronic acid in the formula with penetrating the skin barrier and leaving skin smoother and plumper; no other reviewer discusses barrier effects specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including one with extremely sensitive skin who normally reacts to new products with hives or rashes, report no breakouts at all; against this, one reviewer says it caused small allergy bumps on her face even though it worked well on her hair.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the mist reduces and prevents an oily look for makeup worn over it; no other reviewer specifically addresses its effect on skin oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Fresh, natural rose scent, not overpowering
Some report inconsistent scent or formula between batches
Larger refill comes in plastic, not the original glass
A few report a leaking spray cap or broken cap on arrival
Doubles well as a hair mist, not just a facial toner
Good value for the price and bottle size

extraits.titre: Refreshing and gentle mist with a natural rose scentRefreshing and gentle mist with a natural rose scent
extraits.texte: This rose water spray is very refreshing and easy to use throughout the day. The mist is fine and spreads evenly on the skin and hair without feeling heavy or sticky. It works well as a toner after cleansing, a makeup refresher, or a light hydration boost during dry weather. I like that it is made with organic rosewater and does not feel harsh on sensitive skin. The natural rose scent is light and pleasant, not overpowering. It also works nicely on hair and locs to add a bit of moisture and shine. For very dry skin, it works best when layered with a moisturizer afterward, since it is more of a refreshing mist than a deep hydrator. Overall, it is a versatile and gentle product for everyday skincare and hair care.

extraits.titre: Simple Skin Maintenance Anyone Can Use- Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: This is by far the BEST multipurpose face product to date. This Rose water toner moisturizes my skin and brings out my natural glow on a bare face. It seals up my large pores as shown in the picture and it doesn't contain any harsh chemicals. It smells refreshing, it's lightweight, and does not leave a film or residue after use. It doesn't dry out my skin like other toners have in the past either. Plus, anyone can use it, male and female alike for clean, refreshing skin. This product stand apart from many others because I have extremely sensitive skin and it has NEVER broken my skin out. Generally when I try any new product, I have a negative reaction (hives or rash) but this product did not result in either. A WIN IS A WIN!!! This Rosewater also works wonders with makeup. It sets my makeup very well and reduces and prevents the oily look for the makeup that I wear. It also makes my makeup look really smooth. The price point is excellent and affordable and it works well with other products from the skincare line. Don't hesitate or second guess. Just try it.

extraits.titre: Fabulous Organic Rose Water Toner Spray For Face, Neck, Hair, And Scalp!
extraits.texte: Update April 20, 2025: I continue to love this Organic Rose Water Toner for face, neck, scalp, and hair care. So soothing and refreshing. Ordered the 8 ounce refill, a terrific value! == Original Review: I have very sensitive skin, including my scalp. A delicate spray on toner is a must have in my daily skin and scalp care routine. Unfortunately, the toner I had been using was becoming too expensive for my budget. Thought I would give this USDA Certified Bulgarian Rosewater Facial Toner a try. So happy I did, this product is a keeper! Everything about it exceeded my expectations. - So versatile! Great for skin, scalp, and hair care. Apply a spritz over facial makeup to freshen up your day. - USDA Certified Organic. That's important to me. - The product has a soft rose fragrance that does not interfere with any perfume/fragrances I am wearing. - So soothing and refreshing! Does not irritate my sensitive skin and scalp, and works great as a styling product on my very fine, pixie cut short hair. A terrific value, too. I highly recommend this product.

This spray is the pick-me-up I need mid-day at work. My skin gets pretty dry working in air conditioning when it's use to humidity (we don't have air conditioning our house), and with a surgical mask rubbing on my face most of the day, my skin isn't too happy. I've been misting this on around 1pm, about 4, 1/2 sprays for my whole face and I can feel and see the difference, and so can my coworkers! My skin looks less dry and pasty and has more of a glow. It also looks less irritated around my nose and mouth area where my mask rubs. I usually only wear some tinted lotion, mascara, and eyebrow tint, so I can't say how it works over full makeup, but it doesn't make my mascara or eyebrows smudge. The scent is very light, like roses and maybe a hint of cherry to me, but dissipates quickly once on, so it's not annoying.

I LOVE IT, I spray this daily after wiping my face with witch Hazel, works like a charm. It has been a struggle trying to find a skin care line that really works for my type of skin, oily many dark spots I loved to pick my skin and it was on my face neck and chest. Since using this in combination with other products. My skin has improved TREMENDOUSLY, I haven't even been to a dermatologist I prefer to find something natural first,always. And this works for me!
